name: IDC `cptac_ucec`
what: IDC v24 collection cptac_ucec (TCIA doi:10.7937/k9/tcia.2018.3r3juisw), tier 1 of the anomaly harvest: 66 subjects and 66 CT series verified on fetch (DICOM), about 10.3 GB; chest, abdomen, pelvis and whole body
level_truth: the data platform records no level labels from the release; its own automatic level calls, which no radiologist has read, are kept apart under its anomaly_harvest folder
how_to_get: Covered by the data platform's pooled IDC route (idc_tier1), which fetches all 39 tier-1 collections, 3,600 series, into its idc folder in one resumable job; this collection alone is that route's manifest idc_tier1.csv filtered on its first column to cptac_ucec, submitted with spinesurg-ct-nnunet's slurm/acquisition_fetch.sh idc while no other fetch of the idc folder runs, since every IDC entry shares its fetch folder; the check is the count of its distinct series in idc/fetch/verified.jsonl, 66.

The route as the manifest prints it: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py --grid idc_cptac_ucec; on the grid, from ~/spinesurg-ct-nnunet/data_platform/reacquire, sbatch -D "$PWD" --export=ALL,IDS="idc_cptac_ucec",MODE=--run reacquire.sbatch, as a Slurm job on the owner's word.
